scopeEvidence.phaseMeans: benchmark.work or engineWork divided by benchmark.frames
scopeEvidence.frameWork: last CPU frame and last available GPU counter sample; GPU value expires after500ms at frame start
scopeEvidence.drawsAndTriangles: current endpoint counters, not interval averages
scopeEvidence.compilation: backend other means WebGPU hooks do not measure WebGL shader compilation

limits: CPU wall time is not thread utilization
Engine scopes are nested and may overlap; do not add them
CPU and GPU overlap; do not sum them into frame duration
Endpoint GPU range is not mean or p95 GPU timing
No per-pass GPU attribution or CPU sampled stack added by this analysis
